description: Plan-vs-ground-truth decomposition accuracy and execution success gate for plan-execute-agent-pattern. Each case is one scenario from that repo's scripts/benchmark_plan_vs_reactive.py, run for real through the repo's actual PlanExecuteAgent.run() (src/plan_execute_agent_pattern/engine.py) and a new ReactiveBaselineAgent that reuses the same Executor/Synthesizer stub interfaces but decides one step at a time instead of planning upfront. Deterministic Planner/Executor/Synthesizer stubs, no LLM, no API key. Uses the registry's existing router_invariant scorer ('equals') rather than a new scorer kind, since router_invariant's generic equals contract already fits exact-match deterministic checks. See plan-execute-agent-pattern/docs/receipts/benchmark.md for full methodology.
